# Release 1.4.0 (13 November 2026)

### Features
- save carts for logged-out users for 30 days [9f2c1e7]
- BREAKING - orders endpoint now returns prices in cents [7a0e5d3]
- dark mode for the account page [5e6f7a9]

### Bug fixes
- total ignored the discount code on mobile [e41c9b2]
- search box lost focus after the first letter [c8d2f61]
- password reset links never expired [f4a5b6c]

### Other
- bump typescript to 5.9 [3b7d0aa]
- cache node_modules between jobs [0d9e4b8]
- add checkout regression suite [b1c2d3e]

# Release 2.0.0 (20 November 2026)

### Features
- download invoices as PDF [a7c3e19]
- invite teammates by email [9e4b7d1]
- BREAKING - remove the deprecated /v1/customers endpoint [c3f8a60]

### Bug fixes
- VAT rounded the wrong way for totals ending in .5 [6d0a2c5]
- date picker showed the wrong month in Safari [e8a9b0c]
- uploaded files could be read by other accounts [7f8a9b0]

### Other
- explain the new invoice API in the README [2be81f4]
- run prettier on the whole repo [11d5e7b]
- results load twice as fast on large catalogues [4c5d6e7]
- switch bundler to vite [0a1b2c3]

# Release 0.9.2 (1 December 2026)

### Features
- BREAKING - config file renamed from .toolrc to tool.toml [8c4b2f7]
- new `tool doctor` command checks your setup [e2a7c90]

### Bug fixes
- --quiet flag still printed warnings [5d1e9a2]
- upgrade yaml parser to patch remote code execution (CVE-2026-4411) [1a9c5e4]
- crash on Windows paths with spaces [d7e8f9a]

### Other
- update lockfile [b6f3d18]
- snapshot tests for the doctor command [3c4d5e6]

# Release 3.2.0 (8 December 2026)

### Features
- offline maps for saved trips [f0e1d2c]
- BREAKING - trips endpoint paginates by default, 50 per page [b0c1d2e]
- share a trip with a link that expires [3f4a5b6]
- remove the legacy trip importer [d3e4f5a]

### Bug fixes
- edits made offline were lost after login [6e7f8a9]
- map pins overlapped on small screens [1f2a3b4]
- shared links exposed the owner's email address [5c6d7e8]

### Other
- run e2e tests on pull requests only [a3b4c5d]
- add architecture diagram [7c8d9e0]
- remove unused images [9f0a1b2]

# Release 1.11.0 (5 January 2027)

### Features
- spell check for 14 languages [2a3b4c5]
- BREAKING - drop support for Internet Explorer 11 [e5f6a7b]
- export documents as Markdown [8a9b0c1]

### Bug fixes
- undo skipped every second change [0a1b2c3]
- session tokens were written to the browser console [4d5e6f7]
- tables pasted from Excel lost their borders [a8b9c0d]

### Other
- produce arm64 builds [6d7e8f9]
- raise coverage of the export module [c2d3e4f]
- rename internal variables [c1d2e3f]

# Release 4.0.1 (19 January 2027)

### Features
- BREAKING - annual plans now renew on the purchase date, not the 1st of the month [1e2f3a4]
- pause a subscription for up to 3 months [7e8f9a0]

### Bug fixes
- receipts showed the wrong currency symbol [5b6c7d8]
- verify signatures so forged webhooks are rejected [3b4c5d6]
- csv export cut off rows after 10,000 [1b2c3d4]

### Other
- pin runner image [7b8c9d0]
- fix typos in CONTRIBUTING [9e0f1a2]
